applied_patches: Local vendor-checkout only (not committed upstream): retarget notifyhook + WinXShell PlatformToolset to v143.
Local vendor-checkout only: set WindowsTargetPlatformVersion to 10.0.26100.0.
Local vendor-checkout only: WinXShell AdditionalLibraryDirectories uses $(OutDir) so notifyhook.lib resolves for x64.
Build notifyhook.dll separately, then WinXShell.exe Release|x64.
build_instructions: Install Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools.
Retarget notifyhook/notifyhook.vcxproj and WinXShell_VS2015.vcxproj to PlatformToolset=v143 and WindowsTargetPlatformVersion=10.0.26100.0 (or another installed SDK).
Stage notifyhook.lib where WinXShell can link it (x64\Release and/or Release).
Copy WinXShell.exe and notifyhook.dll into third_party/winxshell/ (gitignored) and record SHA-256 here.
Ship WinXShell.jcfg beside the EXE for wallpaper/taskbar/start-menu power commands.
notes: Do not vendor opaque WinXShell packs, Strelec builds, explorer.exe, or Windows system DLLs.
notifyhook.dll is required at runtime beside WinXShell.exe.
local_test_only means experimental lab use only; not redistributable/approved.
Desktop-shell ISO remains experimental until physical Ventoy smoke completes.
